title: Seedream 4.5 Prompt Schema
description: JSON schema for validating Seedream 4.5 image generation prompts produced by this skill.

prompt.description: Natural language scene description. Recommended 50-200 words. Maximum 600 words per BytePlus documentation. Write in coherent sentences, not keyword lists.

negative_prompt.description: Elements to exclude from generation. Use sparingly. Examples: 'distorted anatomy, blurry, low quality, text artifacts, extra fingers'

size.description: Resolution preset. 1K=~1024px, 2K=~2048px, 4K=~4096px. Use 'custom' with width/height for exact dimensions.

width.description: Custom output width in pixels. Only used when size='custom'. Max 4096.

height.description: Custom output height in pixels. Only used when size='custom'. Max 4096.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. 'auto' matches input image aspect ratio. For cinematic stills, default to 16:9.

guidance_scale.description: Controls how closely the output follows the prompt. Higher values = more literal interpretation. Typical range 6-10. Default 8.0.

steps.description: Number of inference steps. More steps = higher quality but slower generation. 40 is a good balance.

seed.description: Seed for reproducible results. Use same seed with identical prompt to reproduce output. Use nearby seeds (±1-5) for minor variations.

max_images.description: Number of images to generate per request. For multi-image consistency, use with sequential_image_generation='auto'.

image_urls.description: Reference image URLs for character consistency, style matching, or image editing. Max 14 images.

sequential_image_generation.description: Batch generation mode. Set to 'auto' for multi-image consistency (story steps, character angles, variations).

watermark.description: Whether to add a watermark to the output image.

metadata.description: Pipeline metadata for tracking and continuity. Not sent to the API.

character_ids.description: Character identifiers referenced in this prompt

continuity_anchor.description: Whether this image serves as a continuity reference for other shots

skill_version.description: Version of the SKILL that generated this prompt

generation_intent.description: What this generation is being used for in the production pipeline

examples.prompt: A confident woman in her early 30s with auburn shoulder-length hair, warm brown eyes, and light freckles across her nose, wearing a navy wool peacoat over a cream turtleneck. She stands at the edge of a rain-soaked city bridge at dusk, looking out at the glowing skyline. Cinematic photography style, 35mm lens, neon city lights reflected in wet pavement, moody blue-orange color palette, atmospheric fog.
examples.negative_prompt: distorted anatomy, blurry, low quality, extra fingers, text
